scope: Fix two review findings in selected AC1018 TABLE merge reconstruction: an excess cell marker must not publish inferred partial ranges, and sparse merges must not reserve range storage proportional to all cells. No writer/output or native geometry qualification.

extraCell.observed: A source-authored valid 1×2 anchor/covered grid followed by a bare excess group 171 returned read=1, semanticComplete=0, ranges=1. The incomplete record exposed a partial inferred range.

sparseReserve.observed: Direct TABLE decoder on a 1×1000 grid with one merge returned one range with capacity 500. Allocation was bounded but needlessly proportional to all cells.

implementation: An excess AC1018 171 marks merge observation invalid before finalization, suppressing all inferred ranges; a linear candidate count bounds range reservation by actual anchors. Occupancy still remains bounded by the existing cell limit, and failure is caught at the noexcept finalizer.

adapterObject.note: The adapter source and MATERIAL header were frozen but uncommitted during the shared normal build; their exact source bindings and subsequent commits are recorded in simultaneousWork.

normalValidation.result: 8/8 passed as reported; no retained test-log hash asserted
normalValidation.sparseControl: ASCII and binary 1×1000, one merge; limit each allocation only during the finalizer to 2048 bytes. Both complete and publish the expected single range without any blocked allocation. This checks a bounded operational allowance rather than an exact vector capacity.

asanValidation.result: 8/8 passed as reported; ASan does not qualify native semantics

limitations: The inferred anchor/covered grammar and original full TABLE semantics retain the limits of the prior receipt.
No staged writer output, group-289 default, native rendering, FreeCAD or full-document claim follows.
DRW_Table layout changed in the earlier merge implementation; formal ABI/API and consumer rebuild qualification remain open.
Before-input fixtures were created locally from scratch and remain in ignored scratch, not Git.

simultaneousWork.chronology: Both sources were frozen during normal and ASan builds while uncommitted, then committed separately after the TABLE code commit.
